source: Read-only class_ability_assignments x abilities x base_abilities + applied_statuses/classes export at 2026-10-03T20:44:01.843Z from configured Supabase REST endpoint; local approved Battle Cry/Grand Finale/Consecrate/Rend edits follow; database unchanged.

statuses.label: Bleed
statuses.admin_notes: Enemy-side physical DoT used by on-hit effects and Rend.

statuses.label: Chilled
statuses.admin_notes: Reusable damage-amplification debuff. Duration is authoritative as combat ticks.

statuses.label: Ignite
statuses.admin_notes: Enemy-side fire DoT. Applied by successful Orbs of Fire orb attacks.

statuses.label: Poison
statuses.admin_notes: Enemy-side DoT. Applied by the Assassin On-Hit Stance (Envenom).

statuses.label: Scorched
statuses.admin_notes: Light, flat burn with no attribute scaling. Preserves Fireball's legacy on-hit burn exactly (25% / 3 per tick / 6s / 3 stacks).

abilities.label: Backstab
abilities.description: Strike at a vital point. Rolls your equipped weapon damage + DEX + ability bonus (unarmed falls back to 1d4).
abilities.tooltip: Vital strike. Rolls weapon damage + DEX + bonus.

amountCalc.note: weapon die + stat + (3 + soft stat + level/3)

combatText.hit_text: {caster}'s blade finds a vital point on {target} from behind. [{damage}]

abilities.label: Cloak of Shadows
abilities.description: Wrap yourself in shadow. Dodge chance scales with CHA (theatrical misdirection), duration scales with DEX.
abilities.tooltip: Chance to dodge attacks. Dodge scales with CHA, duration with DEX.

combatText.activate_text: Cloak of Shadows! {dodge_pct}% dodge chance for {seconds}s.

abilities.label: Envenom
abilities.description: Stance. Each hit may apply a stackable poison DoT — proc chance scales with DEX, max stack ceiling scales with CHA. Mutually exclusive with Orbs of Fire. Click again to drop.
abilities.tooltip: Hits may apply stacking poison. Proc scales with DEX, max stacks with CHA. Stance.

combatText.activate_text: Envenom! Your weapons drip with poison.

abilities.label: Eviscerate
abilities.description: A vicious finisher. Rolls your equipped weapon damage + DEX + ability bonus, then multiplied by consumed poison stacks (per-stack bonus scales with CHA showmanship). Unarmed falls back to 1d4.
abilities.tooltip: Rolls weapon damage + DEX + bonus, multiplied by poison stacks (CHA).

amountCalc.note: base damage before the poison-stack multiplier

per_stack_multiplier.note: CHA bonus per consumed poison stack

abilities.label: Shadowstep
abilities.description: Vanish into shadow — duration scales with DEX, and your next strike from stealth deals an ambush multiplier scaling with CHA (cap ×2.5).
abilities.tooltip: Vanish into stealth; next strike is an ambush. Duration scales with DEX, ambush with CHA.

combatText.activate_text: {ability}! You vanish into the shadows for {seconds}s (ambush x{mult}).

abilities.label: Crescendo
abilities.description: A rising melody that heals all nearby allies over time. Heal/tick scales with CHA; duration scales with INT.
abilities.tooltip: Heal nearby allies over time. Heal scales with CHA, duration with INT.

combatText.cast_text: Crescendo! A rising melody heals {who} every 3s for {seconds}s.

abilities.label: Cutting Words
abilities.description: Unleash a barbed insult that wounds your target, scaling with CHA
abilities.tooltip: Damage one target. Scales with CHA.

abilities.label: Dissonance
abilities.description: A discordant note that reduces your target's damage. Reduction magnitude scales with CHA (cutting cadence), duration scales with INT.
abilities.tooltip: Reduce target's damage. Reduction scales with CHA, duration with INT.

abilities.label: Grand Finale
abilities.description: Unleash a devastating crescendo of sound (CHA-scaled damage). INT sharpens the killing note — each point of INT widens the crit-edge.
abilities.tooltip: Burst damage on one target. Damage scales with CHA, crit-edge with INT.

amountCalc.note: CHA-scaled burst; no additional bonus die

combatText.hit_text: {ability}!{crit} {caster} unleashes a devastating blast of sound at {target}! [{damage}]

abilities.label: Inspire
abilities.description: A song that grants you and your party flat HP & CP regen, scaling with your Charisma. Duration scales with Intelligence (60–180s). Recasting refreshes the duration and keeps the stronger regen values.
abilities.tooltip: Grant party HP & CP regen. Regen scales with CHA, duration with INT.

abilities.label: Divine Aegis
abilities.description: Create an absorb shield on a targeted ally (or self). Pool scales with WIS; duration (up to 60s) scales with CON.
abilities.tooltip: Shield an ally with an absorb pool. Pool scales with WIS, duration with CON.

combatText.ally_text: Divine Aegis! You shield {target} for up to {seconds}s.
combatText.self_text: Divine Aegis! An absorb shield wraps you for up to {seconds}s.

abilities.label: Heal
abilities.description: Restore HP based on your Wisdom
abilities.tooltip: Restore your HP. Scales with WIS.

combatText.self_text: You cast Heal and mend your wounds!
combatText.self_full_text: You cast Heal but you're already at full health.

abilities.label: Purifying Light
abilities.description: A wave of divine radiance that heals all nearby allies over time. Heal/tick scales with WIS; duration scales with CON (stamina sustains the radiance).
abilities.tooltip: Heal nearby allies over time. Heal scales with WIS, duration with CON.

combatText.cast_text: Purifying Light! Divine radiance heals {who} every 3s for {seconds}s.

abilities.label: Smite
abilities.description: Channel a burst of divine light at your target, scaling with WIS
abilities.tooltip: Damage one target. Scales with WIS.

abilities.label: Transfer Health
abilities.description: Sacrifice your own HP (amount = WIS) to heal a targeted ally. CON sets your safety floor — hardy healers can give more without dropping themselves low.
abilities.tooltip: Sacrifice HP to heal an ally. Scales with WIS; CON sets your safety floor.

combatText.no_hp_text: You don't have enough HP to transfer! (need to keep {reserve} HP)

abilities.label: Aimed Shot
abilities.description: A careful shot. Rolls your equipped weapon damage + DEX + ability bonus (unarmed falls back to 1d4).
abilities.tooltip: Careful shot. Rolls weapon damage + DEX + bonus.

amountCalc.note: weapon die + stat + (3 + soft stat + level/3)

abilities.label: Barrage
abilities.description: Fire a volley of arrows. Each arrow rolls your equipped weapon damage (unarmed: 1d4) + half DEX. Arrow count scales with WIS: 2 base, +1 with DEX≥3, +1 more with WIS≥4 (max 4).
abilities.tooltip: Volley of arrows. Each rolls weapon damage + half DEX; count scales with WIS.

amountCalc.note: per-arrow damage: weapon die + half DEX

abilities.label: Disengage
abilities.description: Leap backward — dodge all attacks briefly. Dodge duration scales with DEX, next-strike bonus damage scales with WIS (calm aim).
abilities.tooltip: Dodge briefly; next strike deals bonus damage. Bonus scales with WIS, duration with DEX.

combatText.activate_text: Disengage! You leap back — dodging all attacks for {seconds}s. Your next strike deals +{bonus_pct}% bonus damage!

abilities.label: Eagle Eye
abilities.description: Stance. Widens your critical hit range based on a blend of DEX (precision) and WIS (attunement) while active. Click again to drop.
abilities.tooltip: Widen your crit range. Scales with DEX and WIS. Stance.

durationCalc.note: legacy timed preview path (stance has no duration)

combatText.activate_text: Eagle Eye! Your crit range is now {crit_low}-20 for {seconds}s.

abilities.label: Nature's Snare
abilities.description: Entangle your target. Damage-reduction magnitude scales with DEX (precise binding), duration scales with WIS.
abilities.tooltip: Reduce target's damage. Reduction scales with DEX, duration with WIS.

amountCalc.note: WIS-scaled damage reduction (live formula uses the scaling stat)

abilities.label: Consecrate
abilities.description: Node-wide pulses heal eligible allies and damage all eligible hostile living creatures on the node, including creatures not currently fighting the Templar.
abilities.tooltip: Heal eligible allies and damage eligible hostile living creatures across the node.

amountCalc.note: WIS heal/burn per tick, x0.65 balance rider

combatText.cast_text: You consecrate the ground — hallowed light wells up beneath your feet for {duration}s, mending allies and searing the unholy.

abilities.label: Divine Challenge
abilities.description: Reduces each incoming hit by a flat amount. Mitigation scales with WIS (min 6, up to ~24 at high WIS), duration scales with CON.
abilities.tooltip: Flat damage reduction per hit. Min 6, up to ~24 at high WIS; duration scales with CON.

combatText.self_text: Divine Challenge! You mitigate incoming blows for {seconds}s. [{amount}]

abilities.label: Holy Shield
abilities.description: Stance. Attackers who strike you take holy damage in return — WIS scaling reduced 20%, with a CON kicker (CON adds to retaliation damage). Once per attacker per tick. Click again to drop.
abilities.tooltip: Attackers take holy damage in return. WIS scaling reduced 20%, CON adds a kicker. Stance.

durationCalc.note: legacy timed preview path (stance has no duration)

abilities.label: Judgment
abilities.description: Pass divine judgment, dealing holy damage scaling with WIS
abilities.tooltip: Holy damage to one target. Scales with WIS.

abilities.label: Shield Wall
abilities.description: Stance. Dual-primary: WIS adds bonus block chance (+25.5% floor, up to +46.75% at high WIS), CON adds bonus block amount (+~4 floor, up to +~9 at high CON). Final block chance capped at 95%. Requires a shield equipped to benefit. Click again to drop.
abilities.tooltip: Boost block chance and amount. Chance scales with WIS, amount with CON. Stance.

block_chance.note: WIS bonus block chance (clamped to 95% at the call site)

abilities.label: Battle Cry
abilities.description: Stance. Reduces incoming damage, with a small shield bonus, and reduces enemy critical-hit chance against you by 10 percentage points. Click again to drop.
abilities.tooltip: Damage reduction plus 10 percentage points less enemy crit chance. Stance.

amountCalc.note: STR magnitude; +0.05 DR with a shield equipped

abilities.label: Power Strike
abilities.description: A heavy, focused blow. Rolls your equipped weapon damage + STR + ability bonus (unarmed falls back to 1d4).
abilities.tooltip: Heavy blow. Rolls weapon damage + STR + bonus.

amountCalc.note: weapon die + stat + (3 + soft stat + level/3)

abilities.label: Rend
abilities.description: Apply stackable Bleed that ticks every 2s. Per-tick damage scales with STR; duration scales with DEX. An initial weapon-based physical hit is deferred until its damage formula is designed.
abilities.tooltip: Stackable STR-scaled Bleed; DEX duration. No initial weapon hit yet.

combatText.miss_text: Rend glances off {target} — no wound opens.
combatText.apply_text: rends {target} — blood weeps from the gash! [{damage}/tick]

abilities.label: Second Wind
abilities.description: Catch your breath and recover HP based on CON
abilities.tooltip: Recover your HP. Scales with CON.

combatText.self_text: You use Second Wind and catch your breath!
combatText.self_full_text: You use Second Wind but you're already at full health.

abilities.label: Sunder Armor
abilities.description: A crushing blow that reduces your target's AC by a STR-scaled amount. Duration scales with DEX (precise strike, lasting weakness).
abilities.tooltip: Reduce target's AC. Amount scales with STR, duration with DEX.

abilities.label: Arcane Surge
abilities.description: Stance. All your damage is increased — bonus magnitude scales with INT. Click again to drop.
abilities.tooltip: Increase all your damage. Bonus scales with INT. Stance.

combatText.activate_text: Arcane Surge! Your damage is amplified (x{mult}).

abilities.label: Conflagrate
abilities.description: Consume all burn stacks on your target for bonus damage per stack. Per-stack bonus scales with INT; stack count scales with WIS via Orbs of Fire.
abilities.tooltip: Consume burn stacks for bonus damage. Per-stack scales with INT.

amountCalc.note: INT base damage before the burn-stack multiplier

per_stack_multiplier.note: INT bonus damage per consumed burn stack

abilities.label: Fireball
abilities.description: Hurl a ball of arcane flame at your target, scaling with INT
abilities.tooltip: Damage one target. Scales with INT.

abilities.label: Force Shield
abilities.description: Stance. Maintains an arcane absorb shield (WIS-scaled pool, INT-scaled regen) that re-forms out of combat. Click again to drop.
abilities.tooltip: Maintain an arcane absorb shield. Pool scales with WIS, regen with INT. Stance.

combatText.self_text: Force Shield! An arcane ward wraps you for {seconds}s.

abilities.label: Frostbolt
abilities.description: A bolt of frost that damages and chills the enemy, causing them to take more damage.
abilities.tooltip: A bolt of frost that damages and chills the enemy, causing them to take more damage.

abilities.label: Orbs of Fire
abilities.description: Stance. While in combat, an orb of fire pulses each heartbeat at your target — proc chance and spark damage scale with INT, and each spark applies the Ignite burn (stacks/duration scale with WIS). Mutually exclusive with Envenom. Click again to drop.
abilities.tooltip: Orbs strike your target and apply Ignite burn. Proc/spark scale with INT, burn with WIS. Stance.

amountCalc.note: INT orb proc chance per heartbeat

combatText.pulse_text: A flaming orb leaps from {attacker} and sears {target} (burn x{stacks})! [{damage}]
combatText.stack_text: {attacker}'s orb of fire seared {target} with Ignite.
combatText.activate_text: Ignite! A shield of fireballs orbits you — each heartbeat in combat, an orb may strike your target.
